title: Recommendations on Filtering of IPv4 Packets Containing IPv4 Options

claims_extracted.claim: RFC 7126 documents operational/security concerns around numerous IPv4 options and recommends restrictive handling for many option types.
The Stream Identifier option is identified as an old RFC 791 option later deprecated and formally obsoleted.

notes: Useful modern operational evidence that the IPv4 options container survives while many branches became filtered or obsolete.
